unit: existing fixed UK records with already adopted explicit compound birthplaces; no new person/DOB binding
question: Can the complete observed compound locality, its explicit type/relation, and an authoritative geography hierarchy disambiguate the existing birthplace without inferring nationality or biography context?
rules: Preserve every literal birth component and all frozen personal fields. Do not use birthplace guesses from nationality, affiliation, parents, schooling, later work/death or publisher footer.

Observe the whole compound name, not only a familiar component. Exact case/space/punctuation normalization allowed; historical spelling aliases only if explicitly documented by an observed original source.

Record candidate geography sources, all returned compatible and incompatible candidates, parent locality/type/region and reasons. Search result titles/snippets alone are leads, not adopted geographic support.

At least one original authoritative geography source must explicitly link the compound components to each other and a regional extent. Seek a second independent geographic witness or a global candidate/type record; distinguish copied source lineages.
A bounded alternative-name query must be attempted; record its actual accessible coverage. A search hit or missing hit never proves global uniqueness.

A hemisphere proposal requires positive compound/type/relation binding, no observed compatible opposing-hemisphere candidate, and sufficient source coverage under independent skeptical review. If coverage cannot establish that the adopted geographic binding is sound, retain unknown; candidate support alone is not a resolved birthplace.

Do not select the largest or famous city. No inferred full spelling, country, unique entity/QID or personal birthpoint coordinates. Type exclusions must follow the original compound wording and be explicitly evidenced.
Geographic support is separately graded and does not upgrade original birthday or birthplace source grades. New map/gazetteer lookup is not a new biographical birth clause.

Source collectors only gather evidence; root and independent QA decide. Preserve rejected alternatives and limitations. Any new decision is versioned and reversible, not final eligibility or cohort freeze.
countercandidate_coverage_limit: No exhaustive-world-coverage claim. Explicitly evaluate whether bounded evidence suffices; otherwise hold.
